UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores the authenticated user's cognitive training profile, XP, streak, psychology law mastery, game high scores, and preferences.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

avatar.description: URL of the user's profile avatar.

title.description: Cognitive rank title earned by the user.

lastActiveDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last activity.

totalGames.description: Total number of cognitive mini-games played.

totalQuizzes.description: Total number of rapid quizzes completed.

quizPoints.description: Cumulative points earned from rapid quizzes.

lawsMastered.description: List of mastered psychology law IDs (bounded to max 50).

lawMasteryMap.description: Map of psychology law ID to mastery percentage (0-100).

bookmarks.description: List of bookmarked psychology law IDs (bounded to max 50).

gameHighScores.description: Map of game ID to highest score achieved.

unlockedBadges.description: List of unlocked achievement badge IDs (bounded to max 50).

selectedGoals.description: List of selected cognitive training goals (bounded to max 20).

hasCompletedOnboarding.description: Whether the user has completed initial onboarding.

isDailyChallengeCompleted.description: Whether the daily cognitive challenge is completed today.

stats.description: Five-dimensional cognitive capability scores (memory, attention, reasoning, knowledge, decision).

weeklyActivity.description: 7-day rolling activity log entries (bounded to max 14).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and cognitive training progress document owned strictly by {userId}.
